people.name: Calneh
people.line: Ancient Mesopotamian city, possibly Kullania or Kullanhu

people.name: Gath
people.line: Philistine city; home of Goliath; refuge for David

people.name: Hamath
people.line: A major city and kingdom in Syria, often mentioned in the Bible.

people.name: Philistia
people.line: An ancient people and region in Canaan

translations.web: Go to Calneh, and see; and from there go to Hamath the great; then go down to Gath of the Philistines. are they better than these kingdoms? or is their border greater than your border?
translations.bsb: Cross over to Calneh and see; go from there to the great Hamath; then go down to Gath of the Philistines. Are you better than these kingdoms? Is their territory larger than yours?
translations.kjv: Pass ye unto Calneh, and see; and from thence go ye to Hamath the great: then go down to Gath of the Philistines: be they better than these kingdoms? or their border greater than your border?
translations.asv: Pass ye unto Calneh, and see; and from thence go ye to Hamath the great; then go down to Gath of the Philistines: are they better than these kingdoms? or is their border greater than your border?
